data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Maliah means 'little mistress'. It is a feminine name derived from the Hebrew word 'mallah', which means 'mistress' or 'lady'. In the Bible, the name Maliah is not found. However, it is mentioned in Jewish tradition as the name of a daughter of King Hezekiah of Judah. The name Maliah carries the meaning “Little mistress” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Maliah usually hope their child will grow to embody little mistress and live with faith, good character and purpose.
